objective: Reduce Qwen3.8-27B CPU bytes and wall time per target-accepted token by stopping MTP proposal chains when their calibrated probability of avoiding a future target verification is below their marginal proposal cost.

decision_rule.q3_weight_only_threshold: compute from the authenticated Q3 artifact after materialization
decision_rule.warning: Raw draft softmax probability is not assumed calibrated. The threshold is applied only after position-conditional calibration on the development split.
decision_rule.purpose: Replace a blind width or confidence sweep with an explicit expected-cost stopping criterion.

instrumentation_required: draft top-1 probability for every proposed position
target accept or reject outcome for every proposed token
draft refresh and per-step wall time
target verification wall time by verified width
sampling commit and rollback wall time
target-only and speculative committed token IDs

development.fit: position-conditional monotone calibration from draft confidence to target acceptance
development.candidate_probability_floors: the analytic cost threshold plus one adjacent lower and higher threshold; no broad grid

controls: fixed-width MTP with probability floor zero
cost-aware MTP using the frozen calibrated stopping rule

stop_rules: reject if the calibrated rule is slower than the best fixed control on heldout prompts
reject if any committed greedy token differs from target only
do not rent the final AMD node if the measured target plus proposal roofline cannot exceed 100 accepted tokens per second with headroom
do not claim scientific novelty from a confidence threshold without a completed literature audit
claim_boundary: Frozen cost model and falsification protocol only; not a 100 tok/s, quality, final-node, or novelty result.
